item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Oil and Gas Prices Jump After Strike Hits Key Energy Site
item.summary: The attack on South Pars, one of the world’s biggest gas fields, showed how the war threatens global energy supplies. Israel killed Iran’s intelligence minister, the latest high-ranking official to be targeted.

item.title: Netanyahu Hopes Strikes on Iran Will Lead to Uprising and Regime Change
item.summary: Israeli attacks have targeted the command centers of Iran’s repressive, internal security forces in hopes that Iranians will overthrow their rulers. Some see that as wishful thinking.

item.title: Trump’s Friendship With Japan’s Leader Takaichi Faces Test Over Iran
item.summary: In Washington on Thursday, President Trump is expected to press Sanae Takaichi for military help in the Strait of Hormuz. But she faces constraints on what she can offer.

item.title: As Iran War Drags On, Europe Wants to Avoid a New Migration Crisis
item.summary: A decade ago, a surge in migration to Europe spurred the far-right’s rise. European leaders now fear the Iran war could set off another crisis, and they have taken tentative steps to prepare.

item.title: Dozens Dead in Pakistani Airstrike on Kabul
item.summary: The attack hit a drug rehabilitation facility, and Afghanistan vowed to retaliate, risking an escalation of the conflict between the two countries.

item.title: At Least 23 Killed in Nigeria as Insurgent Attacks Go On Despite U.S. Help
item.summary: A teaching hospital and two markets in the city of Maiduguri were hit in what a military spokesman said were suicide bombings by Boko Haram.

item.title: Trump Signals He May Intervene in Cuba Following Iran and Venezuela
item.summary: Still at war with Iran and in control in Venezuela, President Trump is signaling that he is about to intervene in another country.

item.title: Sucked Into War, Gulf Countries Face the Limits of U.S. Security Guarantees
item.summary: Barraged by Iranian attacks and questioning the value of security ties with the United States, nations in the Gulf have turned to Ukraine, Australia and Italy for help.

item.title: Israel Has Killed Esmaeil Khatib, Iran’s Intelligence Minister
item.summary: The Israeli military said on Wednesday that it had killed Esmaeil Khatib in an airstrike. Iran confirmed the killing.

item.title: Over 200 Ukrainian Experts in Middle East to Help Fight Drones, Zelensky Says
item.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that 11 countries in the region have asked for Kyiv’s assistance. Russia has launched such drones against Ukraine for years.
